questions.stem_text: Singer argues that developing nations are harming poor nations by

options.A: exploiting their natural resources without adequate compensation.
options.C: forcing them to adopt Western educational systems.
options.D: imposing their political systems on them.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - exploiting their natural resources without adequate compensation.

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following is, according to the introduction to chapter 8, typically defined
as the act or practice of killing or allowing someone to die?
Anscombe claims that an adequate moral psychology would include:

options.A: a detailed understanding of societal norms and expectations.
options.B: a comprehensive review of historical philosophical theories.
options.C: the influence of personal experiences on moral decisions.
options.D: analyses of concepts such as "action" and "intention."
options.E: the integration of religious beliefs into moral decisions.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - analyses of concepts such as "action" and "intention."
